entities.summary: Otto Guevara Guth is a politician in Costa Rica and founder of the Partido Movimiento Libertario. He served in the Costa Rican legislature from 1998-2002 and 2014-2018. Guevara is currently the president of the Libertarian Movement Party and has been its candidate for president of Costa Rica in 2002, 2006, 2010 and 2014.
